description:
These Moroccan pattern tiles for kitchen walls are multi colour glazed ceramic mosaic tiles, the second design (002) in Pak Clay's Moroccan-style kitchen series, made for backsplashes and feature walls.

## How they look
Moroccan-style mosaics combine several colours in a repeating geometric pattern, so a backsplash reads as one decorative panel. Design 002 is a different pattern from [design 001](/products/glazed-multi-colours-moroccan-mosaic-kitchen-wall-tiles-001); the two are easiest to compare on samples side by side. These are made in Pakistan in a Moroccan style, not imported from Morocco.

## Where they work
- **Behind the hob or sink**, where glazed mosaic kitchen tiles are generally easy to wipe.
- **A full kitchen feature wall** or a breakfast-counter wall.
- **Open kitchens**, where the backsplash is seen from the lounge.

Multi colour kitchen wall tiles work best with plain cabinets and a single-colour countertop, so the pattern is the only busy surface.

## Good to know
- Material: glazed ceramic mosaic
- Colour: multi colour
- Style: Moroccan-style pattern (design 002)
- Category: mosaic kitchen wall tiles
- Size and sheet layout: confirm on enquiry

Ask your tiler about a heat-tolerant adhesive and a stain-resistant grout behind the hob, and keep tiles from one batch so the colours match. Clean grease with a mild detergent, not acid.

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) to judge these patterned backsplash tiles in your own kitchen light, then get a dated quote. Browse the [mosaic kitchen wall range](/categories/mosaic-kitchen-wall-tiles).

faqs.q: What is the price of Moroccan pattern kitchen tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the quantity, the area to cover and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Are Pak Clay's Moroccan tiles imported?
faqs.a: No. They are glazed ceramic mosaics in a Moroccan style, offered by Pak Clay in Pakistan. The name describes the pattern, not the country of origin.

faqs.q: What is the difference between design 001 and design 002?
faqs.a: They are two different multi colour patterns in the same Moroccan-style series. Ask for samples of both on WhatsApp and compare them on your kitchen wall.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Moroccan Mosaic Kitchen 002" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
